Class DiscoveryClientStages

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.discovery.DiscoveryClientStages
@Internal public final class DiscoveryClientStages extends Object
Looks up the services of a DiscoveryClient with CompletionStages for the framework: with the AsyncDiscoveryClient methods when the client implements it, and by adapting the publisher methods otherwise. An AsyncDiscoveryClient method that returns no stage, or a stage completed with null, as the methods of a mock may do, is replaced by the publisher method. A method that throws completes the stage with its error.
Since:
5.3.0
